name: io.github.Gliana-Labs/gliana-ai-mcp
title: GlianaAI
description: Pay-per-call AI: 90+ generative models (image, video, music, speech, LLM chat), plus market data and SEC filings. No signup, no API key — each call settles as a USDC micropayment from your own wallet.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid gk_ key from https://dashboard.glianalabs.com. No wallet and no private key in your config; paid calls draw from the key's balance under its server-side daily cap. Takes precedence over any wallet key.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_WALLET_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file (chmod 600) holding a 0x EVM private key for a wallet with USDC on Base/Tempo. Preferred over GLIANA_WALLET_KEY: your MCP client config gets synced, committed and screenshotted; a key file does not. Use a dedicated wallet holding only what you intend to spend. Discovery tools work with no key at all.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x EVM private key, inline. Works, but prefer GLIANA_WALLET_KEY_FILE — an inline key lives in your MCP client config. Discovery tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_SOLANA_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file (chmod 600) holding a Solana secret key. Preferred over GLIANA_SOLANA_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_SOLANA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Solana secret key (base58 or JSON array), inline. Prefer GLIANA_SOLANA_KEY_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_RAIL
environmentVariables.description: Payment rail for generate: base | tempo | solana (default base).

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the gateway base URL (default https://api.glianalabs.com).

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_MAX_PER_CALL_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional spending cap: refuse any paid call priced above this many USD. Checked against the gateway's own 402 quote before anything is paid.

environmentVariables.name: GLIANA_MAX_PER_DAY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional spending cap: refuse a paid call that would take today's total above this many USD. The total survives restarts (~/.gliana-ai-mcp/spend.json).
